Besides the skills of your class, you can learn many buffs of other classes.

Champion monsters drop the %medal%. Double-click it in your inventory to open the Skill Master, and learn any buff of the list for one medal. It is yours for good.

Then press Alt+B and open Buff Templates: save your buffs in a template and cast the whole set on yourself or your summon in one click, without mana or reuse time.

Beginners are still blessed by the Newbie Guide of their village, as of old.

Keep a few medals: they are also the entry fee of the Survival Arena.
